Every 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of Trace restored generates 1 Photo.

abilities.name: Skillful Cooking
abilities.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

abilities.name: Montage
abilities.description:
When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio Chafe DMG against targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is Amplified by 60% for 30s.
This effect ends when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

When in Resonance Mode - Echo, grant 50% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator for 14s.
This effect ends when the incoming Resonator is switched off the field or when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

abilities.name: Locked Thread
abilities.description:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack right after Basic Attack Stage 1 to continuously attack the targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast Heavy Attack Stage 1.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage 1 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack Stage 1 to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after this skill lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding

When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding.
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Single Threading

When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading.
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Dual Threading

When in Algorithm Compaction and Root Access reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Single Threading is replaced with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading.
Consume STA and all Root Access to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Multi-threading

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target. SQL can be consumed for a 270% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction

When in Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction

When in Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 3.

abilities.name: Protocol Breach
abilities.description:
Resonance Skill - Payload

Cast Resonance Skill - Payload to charge forward, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing Spectro DMG and activating Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by 70%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
Press Normal Attack shortly after the follow-up attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference

Cast Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference to cut through the target, dealing Spectro DMG and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting Digital Handshake.
Digital Handshake: When Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains TCP every second. This effect is removed when TCP reaches 100 points or when Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is cast.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Deadlock

When TCP reaches 100 points or Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Cast Resonance Skill - Deadlock to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
Reset the CD of Resonance Skill - Deadlock after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.

abilities.name: Netrunner
abilities.description:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner

Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for 10s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to 7 different Spoofing Program effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with 24 points of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all Spoofing Program effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no Spoofing Program can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when Normal Attack is held down, Override is triggered, which deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any Spoofing Programs, press Normal Attack to trigger Override on all marked targets.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Spoofing Program: Ping
Requires 2 RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals Spectro DMG to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout
Requires 5 RAM. Deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement
Requires 6 RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch
Requires 5 RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by 100% within 30s.
Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis
Requires 6 RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive

When in Algorithm Compaction, after Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is cast, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive. Lucy gains all effects of Resonance Liberation - Netrunner, and the DMG Multiplier of Override is greatly increased.
After casting Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or when Lucy exits the Algorithm Compaction state, Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Netrunner.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

abilities.name: Ghost Cyberware
abilities.description:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for 8s, she gains 1 stacks of Optical Illusion. Max 1 stacks by default.
Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 stacks of Optical Illusion. This effect can be triggered up to 1 times every 0.5s.

abilities.name: Function Cracking
abilities.description:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock damages an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

Network Backdoor

Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain Network Backdoor, and any existing Network Backdoor effects become invalid.

abilities.name: Outdated Hallucination
abilities.description:
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and granting Resonators in the team Involuntary Sharing, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for 25s. Additionally, Involuntary Sharing is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for 4s.
If Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
If Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
After casting this skill, the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 points of TCP.

abilities.name: Depths of Blackwall
abilities.description:
Cloud Portal

When not in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains TCP upon hitting a target. At 100 points of TCP, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive clears all TCP.

Algorithm Compaction

After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains 1 stacks of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 65% for 8s.
While in Algorithm Compaction, casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock again will not grant SQL and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains Root Access upon hitting a target with attacks including Basic Attack - Thread Shredding and Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Reaching 100 points of Root Access replaces Heavy Attack - Single Threading with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. Press or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack - Dual Threading to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by 270% and remove SQL.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy does not have SQL, she loses 20% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below 1%, no HP is consumed.
After casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
Lucy exits the the Algorithm Compaction state after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is not followed up by one of these skills: Normal Attack - Locked Thread, Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach, Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, and Tune Break - Data Crash.

Hack Response - Data Crash

Lucy deals Spectro DMG to a target inflicted with Hack - Interfered and applies the same target with Data Crash, considered Hack DMG.
Data Crash: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for 0.5s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

TCP

Lucy holds up to 100 points of TCP.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference.
After casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, casting the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of TCP.

Root Access

Lucy holds up to 100 points of Root Access.
Lucy gains Root Access when she deals damage through Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, and Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.

abilities.name: Skillful Cooking
abilities.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

abilities.name: Countermeasure Program
abilities.description:
The incoming Resonator gains 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Grants all Resonators in the team Countermeasure Program for 25s.
While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts Hack - Shifting, that Resonator gains 20% All DMG Amplification.
While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them 30% DMG Reduction for 3s and Stagnates their attacker for 1s. This effect can only trigger up to 1 time while Countermeasure Program is active. Obtaining Countermeasure Program again resets the effective charge.
When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the Countermeasure Program early.

abilities.name: Flaming Sakura Blade Art
abilities.description:
Basic Attack - Present Self

Press Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self

When Dedication reaches 300 points, Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of Dedication is consumed and Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available. The arrow applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Present Self

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Present Self

Press Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self

While in Foreclaimed Self, Basic Attack - Present Self is replaced by Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5 each applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self

In Foreclaimed Self, hold Normal Attack to enter Hold Breath, continuously consuming STA. When Normal Attack is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the Hold Breath state and thrusts forward, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. Press Normal Attack within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 instead.

Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self

When Whiteout Bitterfrost is full, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self.
Hold Normal Attack and consume STA and 3 stacks of Whiteout Bitterfrost to gain 1 point of Snowforged Blade, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.

Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self

While in Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Present Self is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3 apply Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
The Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than Basic Attack - Iai within a short period.
Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self

While in Foreclaimed Self, Dodge Counter - Present Self is replaced by Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self.
Press Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3.

abilities.name: Frostblight
abilities.description:
Resonance Skill - Present Self

Deal Glacio DMG.
Casting this skill enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now restores 100 points of Dedication when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.
Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

While in Foreclaimed Self, Resonance Skill - Present Self is replaced by Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall:

Frostblight: Jade Cleave

While on the ground, press Resonance Skill to pull in nearby targets and deal Glacio DMG, removing the targets' Frostbind.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Frostblight: Petalfall.

Frostblight: Petalfall

While in mid-air, press Resonance Skill to pull in nearby targets and deal Glacio DMG, removing the targets' Frostbind.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Frostblight: Jade Cleave.

abilities.name: Foreclaiming
abilities.description:
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision

Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available after casting Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self.
While in Present Self, press Resonance Liberation to cast this skill, dealing Glacio DMG. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of Frostharden Iai, remove 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart. Then, enter Foreclaimed Self and restore 50 points of Frostheart.
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision applies 4 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision does not consume Resonance Energy.

Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation

While in Foreclaimed Self, Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation can be cast via the following ways:
- Press Resonance Liberation and release to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If Hiyuki has 3 points of Snowforged Blade, consume all Snowforged Blade. Otherwise, this cast does not consume Snowforged Blade.
- Hold Resonance Liberation to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of Snowforged Blade periodically. Release Resonance Liberation to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If no Snowforged Blade is consumed when Resonance Liberation is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation will also be cast automatically when Snowforged Blade depletes.
Hiyuki deals Glacio DMG. Each point of Snowforged Blade consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart, and ends Foreclaimed Self.

abilities.name: Fine Snow
abilities.description:
When a Resonator in the team applies Glacio Chafe or Havoc Bane, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of Snow Rust. Snow Rust stacks up to 3 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of Snow Rust, the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
2 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier of 102%.
3 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is additionally Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

abilities.name: Ephemeral Realm
abilities.description: Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers after being knocked out, when she stays out of combat for 4s with fewer than 1 point of Snowforged Blade, restore 1 point.

abilities.name: Frostedge
abilities.description:
Deal Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and apply Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
In Present Self, casting this skill restores 200 points of Dedication. Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.
In Foreclaimed Self, press Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2.

abilities.name: Everfrost Dominion
abilities.description:
Glacio Bite

- While Hiyuki is in the team, Glacio Chafe inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to Glacio Bite. Every time a new stack of Glacio Bite is inflicted on a target, an instance of Glacio Bite DMG is triggered based on that enemy's current Glacio Bite stack limit. Glacio Bite can be inflicted on frozen targets. Glacio Bite is also considered Glacio Chafe and Glacio Bite DMG is also considered Glacio Chafe DMG.
- When Foreclaiming: Inward Vision or Basic Attack - Iai hits a target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of Glacio Bite, consume 10 stacks and trigger Frostbind once.
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of Glacio Chafe from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite, all enemies' Glacio Bite stacks are cleared.

Present Self

Hiyuki starts in Present Self. While in Present Self, casting certain skills restores Dedication.

Foreclaimed Self

Hiyuki enters Foreclaimed Self after casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. While in Foreclaimed Self, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores Frostheart through certain attacks.

Iai Stance

If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of Frostheart, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter Iai Stance:
- Press Dodge after casting any Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, Frostblight: Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, or Intro Skill - Frostedge.
- Hold Resonance Skill within a certain period after casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters Iai Stance.
Hiyuki may enter Iai Stance while airborne. Upon entering the Iai Stance, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. Iai Stance ends if Hiyuki is switched out.

Basic Attack - Iai

Within a certain period after entering Iai Stance, press Normal Attack and consume 100 points of Frostheart to cast Basic Attack - Iai, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If Frostheart remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a certain period to cast Basic Attack - Iai again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during Basic Attack - Iai, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time Basic Attack - Iai is cast, if Hiyuki has Frostharden Iai, consume 1 point of Frostharden Iai to inflict 3 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit, and gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Dedication

Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Dedication.
While in Present Self, Dedication may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 restores 100 points of Dedication.
- Casting Intro Skill - Frostedge restores 200 points of Dedication.
Casting Resonance Skill - Present Self enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now additionally restores 100 points of Dedication. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.

Frostheart

Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Frostheart.
Frostheart is restored while casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall, or when Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self hits the target.

Frostharden Iai

Frostharden Iai has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision grants 3 points of Frostharden Iai.

Whiteout Bitterfrost

Whiteout Bitterfrost stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Frostharden Iai is consumed through Basic Attack - Iai, gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Snowforged Blade

Snowforged Blade stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self is cast, gain 1 stack of Snowforged Blade.

abilities.name: Skillful Cooking
abilities.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

abilities.name: Snowlight Blessing
abilities.description: Glacio DMG dealt by nearby Resonators other than Hiyuki in the team is Amplified by 20% against targets affected by Glacio Chafe for 20s.

abilities.name: Deterrence
abilities.description:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Parry Stance

Hold Normal Attack to enter Parry Stance at the cost of STA.
While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes 60% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release Normal Attack to exit Parry Stance and perform Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble to cast Mid-air Attack - Havoc
In Parry Stance, use Dodge to consume STA to perform Dodge: Flicker, which can trigger successful Dodges during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Havoc

Perform up to 3 consecutive strikes, dealing Havoc DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting Stage 3 of this skill to perform Basic Attack - Repel.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Launch the Cloudrift Bolt and grapple towards the target, dealing Electro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after to cast Basic Attack - Repel, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

abilities.name: Ultimate Tactics
abilities.description: Launch the Thunder Quietus, dealing Electro DMG.

abilities.name: Decipher
abilities.description: Resonance Skill Overshock inflicts 10 stacks of Electro Flare on the target it damages.

abilities.name: Regression
abilities.description: When Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, gain 20% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 20s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.

abilities.name: Thunderous Fury
abilities.description: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

abilities.name: Myriad Omens' Mandate
abilities.description:
Overshock

At max Electric Surge, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Overshock, dealing Electro DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Normal Attack Stage 4.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by pressing the button, clear all Electric Surge to grant Resonators in the team 10% ATK Bonus for 20s.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, consume 60 points of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all Electric Surge to enter Apex Resonance.

Apex Resonance

While in Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds is unlocked, which consumes 10% Thunder Rage per second:
While on the ground, press Resonance Skill to launch up to 7 consecutive attacks:
- The first 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro, dealing Spectro DMG.
- The next 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The last 1 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade, dealing Aero DMG.
While on the ground, hold Resonance Skill to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero, dealing Aero DMG and leaping into the air.
While airborne, press Resonance Skill to perform up to 6 stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first 3 stages: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The next 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=A}: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=B}: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG. Press Resonance Skill shortly after landing to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade.
Hold Resonance Skill in mid-air to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack.
Each time Thrum of All Sounds hits the target, Thunder Bane is triggered, dealing Electro DMG to the target within range, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
While in Apex Resonance, press Resonance Skill shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific Thrum of All Sounds skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.

Electric Surge

Rover can hold up to 120 points of Electric Surge.
Electric Surge is restored when Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Normal Attack - Deterrence, Resonance Skill - Thunderclap, or Basic Attack - Repel deals damage.

Thunder Rage

Rover can hold up to 100 points of Thunder Rage.
Entering Apex Resonance restores Thunder Rage to the max limit.
Thunder Rage is restored when Thrum of All Sounds deals damage.

abilities.name: Skillful Cooking
abilities.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

abilities.name: Rumbling Thunders
abilities.description:
The incoming Resonator gains Electro Core for 20s or until the Resonator is switched out. After Resonators with Electro Core inflict Negative Statuses, their Electro Core is consumed, and they gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.
Casting Outro Skill ends the Apex Resonance state and clears all Thunder Rage.

abilities.name: Succor and Smite
abilities.description:
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance

Press Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance

Press Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance

Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

abilities.name: Feather's Edge
abilities.description:
Sword Stance Switch

While in Azure Sword Stance, press Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

While in Feather Sword Stance, press Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

Sword Stance Switch: Azure

Press Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

Sword Stance Switch: Feather

Press Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

abilities.name: Hush of a Thousand Voices
abilities.description:
Hush of a Thousand Voices

Consume all Melody to deal Havoc DMG and restore 1 point of Azure Plume. This DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Upon casting this skill, obtain Voice upon Voice. When casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, summon Shadow of Xuanling to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Voice upon Voice cannot stack. Once Shadow of Xuanling is summoned, the Voice upon Voice state is removed.

abilities.name: Unbroken Vow
abilities.description:
When a target has 1 to 3 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack of Havoc Bane Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by 10%, up to 30%.

When a target has 4 to 6 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack of Havoc Bane Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by 12%, up to 36%.

abilities.name: One Life, One Blade
abilities.description:
Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices raises the Havoc Bane stacks on the targets to the maximum on hit.

When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Windbound. Windbound can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times.

When Windbound reaches 6 stacks, Yangyang: Xuanling removes all Windbound and gains One with the Wind.
While One with the Wind lasts, when Yangyang: Xuanling casts Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, she summons Feather Release: Xuanling to attack the target, applying 6 stacks of Havoc Bane to the target.
Windbound cannot be obtained while One with the Wind lasts.

Once Feather Release: Xuanling is summoned, the One with the Wind state is removed.

abilities.name: Skybound Feather
abilities.description:
Deal Havoc DMG and restore 1 points of Azure Plume.
When Intro Skill - Skybound Feather deals damage, it applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane on the target.

abilities.name: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
abilities.description:
Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure

Yangyang: Xuanling is in Azure Sword Stance by default. When Melody is depleted while in Feather Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure.
Press Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 points of Melody and 1 points of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure hits the target, consume 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather

When Melody is depleted while in Azure Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather.
Press Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 points of Melody and 1 points of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather hits, consume 1 stacks of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 points of Melody.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance

When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Azure Sword Stance, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, gain Bated Breath: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance increases by 160%. When Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance ends, Bated Breath is removed. Bated Breath can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance applies 2 stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance

When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, dealing Havoc DMG. After it hits a target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall is automatically cast.
When casting Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, gain Streaming Storm, which lasts 15s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance or the next Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom is increased by 160%. Streaming Storm is removed when Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 ends. Streaming Storm can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance applies 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall

When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance and airborne, Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall.
Press or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall enters Hark the Wind for 12s.

Hark the Wind

While in Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During Hark the Wind, a Dodge Counter counts towards the Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle.

Feathered Oath

When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane on a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Feathered Oath for 4s. Feathered Oath can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom by 25%, up to 150%.

Refrain

Before Yangyang: Xuanling's Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, or Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of Havoc Bane on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.

Melody

Melody has a maximum of 100 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather restores 100 points of Melody.
Casting Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices consumes all Melody.
Normal Attacks consumes Melody upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Melody.

Azure Plume

Azure Plume has a maximum of 2 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, or Intro Skill - Skybound Feather restores 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Azure Plume.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices restores 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Azure Plume.
Casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance or Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall consumes all Azure Plume.

abilities.name: Skillful Cooking
abilities.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

abilities.name: As the Wind Wills
abilities.description:
Attacks the target, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 300% of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK.
All Resonators in the team other than Yangyang: Xuanling gains Tonal Switch for 20s. After a Resonator with Tonal Switch inflicts Havoc Bane, that Resonator's Havoc DMG is Amplified by 20%.
This effect is reset upon casting this skill again.

abilities.name: Unraveled Spring
abilities.description:
Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Zephyr Stance

Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance

Press Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 4.

abilities.name: Vernal Screen
abilities.description:
Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance

While in Zephyr Stance and Cloud Breath is not full, press Resonance Skill to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore Cloud Breath.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.

Awakening Spring

While in Zephyr Stance and at full Cloud Breath, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Awakening Spring. Casting this skill consumes all Cloud Breath, pulls in nearby targets, and sends Suisui into Drizzle Stance, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting Glacio Chafe on the target 1 time on hit.

Enrichment

Casting Awakening Spring or Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade grants all nearby Resonators in the team 1 stack of Enrichment. This effect can be triggered once every 25s. Incoming Resonators receive healing from Suisui at the cost of Enrichment.

Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance

While in Drizzle Stance, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.
Press Resonance Skill to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore Floral Epistle.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance.

abilities.name: Song of Thoroughfare
abilities.description:
Casting the skill deploys Ceaseless Landscape that lasts for 30s. When Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui enters the Roaming Transcendent state when casting Outro Skill - Rippling Waters.
Ceaseless Landscape grants all nearby Resonators in the team the following enhancements:
- Inflicting a target with Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, and Aero Erosion, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limit of the corresponding Negative Status the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Inflicting a target with Electro Flare or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limits of Electro Flare and Electro Rage the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Consuming Havoc Bane stacks on the target after landing a skill allows the Resonator's Havoc DMG to ignore the target's DEF by 6% and Havoc RES by 12% for 30s. This effect does not stack.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

abilities.name: Sky Over Water
abilities.description:
Consuming Enrichment grants the Resonator 10 stacks of Spring's Birth, up to 10 stacks. When the Resonator with Spring's Birth is not at full HP, restore their HP by 62 + 0.34% of Suisui's Max HP at the cost of 1 stack of Spring's Birth every 2s.

When Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring and Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade hit a target, they additionally restore 18 points of Concerto Energy and 13 points of Resonance Energy, and increase the attack's Crit. Rate by 80% and Glacio DMG by 240%. This effect can be triggered up to once every 25s.

abilities.name: Glimmering Gold
abilities.description: When a Resonator other than Suisui takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out but will instead regain 50% of Suisui's current HP, while Suisui herself loses the same amount of HP. Suisui's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Tinkling Jade
abilities.description:
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, and inflict Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target.
While casting this skill, consume all Cloud Breath to pull in nearby targets and enter Drizzle Stance.

abilities.name: Lambent Gold
abilities.description:
Zephyr Stance

Suisui is in Zephyr Stance by default. When in Zephyr Stance, Suisui can obtain Cloud Breath through certain skills.

Drizzle Stance

Entering Drizzle Stance clears all Floral Epistle.
During Drizzle Stance:
- Suisui unlocks new combat moves and restores Floral Epistle through certain skills.
-Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
- Press Normal Attack within a certain time after triggering a successful Dodge via Dodge skills to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 1.
After entering Drizzle Stance for 15s, Suisui ends Drizzle Stance and clears all Floral Epistle upon exiting the state.

Dodge - Parting Mist

While performing attacks on the ground, press Dodge to cast Dodge - Parting Mist at the cost of STA.
When in Zephyr Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Cloud Breath. Press Normal Attack shortly after triggering the Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance.
- When in Drizzle Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Floral Epistle, and does not reset the cycle of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance within a certain period.

Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance

When in Drizzle Stance, Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance.
Press Normal Attack repeatedly to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.
When casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 3, continuously pull in nearby targets.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 inflicts Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target on hit.

Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.

Illuminating Dew

When in Drizzle Stance, keep holding Normal Attack after casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Swallow's Cut

When in Drizzle Stance, cast this skill in one of the following ways:
- Release the Normal Attack button while casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance.
- Press Normal Attack while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Cloud Breath

Max 120 points.
When in Zephyr Stance:
- Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance and Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance restore Cloud Breath on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance restores 40 points of Cloud Breath when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 35 points of Cloud Breath.

Floral Epistle

Max 600 points.
When in Drizzle Stance:
- Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance restore Floral Epistle on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance restores 100 points of Floral Epistle when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 102 points of Floral Epistle.

abilities.name: Skillful Cooking
abilities.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

abilities.name: Rippling Waters
abilities.description:
Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent when Ceaseless Landscape is active.
Suisui exits Drizzle Stance and consumes all Floral Epistle and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed:

0 Floral Epistle consumed:
- All nearby Resonators in the team gain Reflecting Shadows for 6s. Resonators with Reflecting Shadows have increased resistance to interruption.

At least 200 Floral Epistle consumed:
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform Plume Step for the first time within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 400 Floral Epistle consumed:
- During this Roaming Transcendent state, the active Resonator within the Ceaseless Landscape deals more DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator deals 0.2% more DMG, up to 12%.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the second Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 600 Floral Epistle consumed:
- When Suisui performs the first Plume Step, all nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape gain the following effects for the duration of this Roaming Transcendent:
- When they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When Resonators with Undulating Mist consume Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's ATK is increased by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When Undulating Mist is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the third Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

Roaming Transcendent

Lasts for 30s.
During Roaming Transcendent, Suisui will merge with Ceaseless Landscape and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform Plume Steps at intervals based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed when Outro Skill - Rippling Waters is cast.
When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.
When Ceaseless Landscape isn't active, she will exit the Roaming Transcendent state.

Plume Step

Performing Plume Step grants Reflecting Shadows to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within the Ceaseless Landscape, and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape.

abilities.name: Strings to Steel
abilities.description:
Basic Attack - Stringblade

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 1 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4 are in Sheathed Stance.
Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2 and Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 are in Drawn Stance.

Heavy Attack - Stringblade

When Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are full, Heavy Attack - Stringblade becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast this skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Qin Heart and Sword Cadence and sends Qingxiao into the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mid-air Attack - Stringblade

Press Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
After landing from Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.
While in mid-air, Resonance Skill is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Plunging Attack

While in the Sword Flight state, Jump is replaced by Plunging Attack.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG.
While out of the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3.

Dodge Counter - Stringblade

Press Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.
Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Sword Glide

While in mid-air, Dodge is replaced by Sword Glide.

abilities.name: Severing Note
abilities.description:
Severing Note: Judgement

Deal Aero DMG. During this skill, gain 45 points of Qin Heart.
While not in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4.

Severing Note: Ascendant

While casting Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 3, or Dodge Counter - Stringblade, Resonance Skill is replaced by Severing Note: Ascendant.
Deal Aero DMG.
This skill is in Drawn Stance.

abilities.name: Billows Beneath Heaven
abilities.description:
Deal Aero DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

abilities.name: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
abilities.description:
Upon entering combat, gain 1 stacks of Gathered Mind.

After damage dealt directly by Resonators in the team defeats a target inflicted with the Mindlock effect:
If Qingxiao does not have the Gathered Mind effect, gain Gathered Mind with stacks equal to the target's Mindlock stacks.
If Qingxiao already has Gathered Mind and the target's Mindlock stacks are no fewer than Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks, Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks will be matched to the target's Mindlock stacks.

Gathered Mind

After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict Mindlock equal to Qingxiao's Gathered Mind stacks. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Resonators in the team cast Tune Break, if the target has Tune Strain - Shifting, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only trigger 1 times on the same target.
When Qingxiao is knocked out, she can no longer gain Gathered Mind, and any existing Gathered Mind effect becomes inactive.
Gathered Mind stacks up to 15 times and lasts for 30s.

abilities.name: To Know, To Banish
abilities.description:
Qingxiao's following skills deal 2% more DMG per stack of Mindlock on the target, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Each time after a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on an Overlord Class or Calamity Class target, additionally inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.

abilities.name: Tonality Shift
abilities.description:
Deal Aero DMG. Casting the skill restores 30 points of Sword Cadence and grants Resonant Chime.

Resonant Chime

Casting Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement grants 30 points of Qin Heart and removes Resonant Chime.

abilities.name: Formless Heart Sword
abilities.description:
Ephemeral Transcendence

While Qingxiao is in the Ephemeral Transcendence state, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence and Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence become available.

Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence

Press repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence

Press or hold Normal Attack within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
Before Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by 100%.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence

When Heart Sword Intent is full, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence becomes available. Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill, dealing Aero DMG.
Casting this skill consumes all Heart Sword Intent and ends the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Mindlock

Mindlock stacks up to 15 times.
Each time a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Interfered on a target, inflict 1 stacks of Mindlock on the target.
For each stack of Mindlock on the target, DMG taken from Qingxiao's following skills is Amplified by 2%, with an additional 5% per stack for the first 7 stacks.
- Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, Resonance Liberation - Billows Beneath Heaven.

Heaven's Clarity

Upon entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation Billows Beneath Heaven, gain Heaven's Clarity.
When Sheathed Stance/Drawn Stance skills deal damage, the rates at which Qin Heart/Sword Cadence are obtained increase by 100%.
When casting Heavy Attack - Stringblade, inflict 3 stacks of Mindlock on nearby targets, and enhance the next Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence: its DMG Multiplier is increased by 100% and it builds additional Off-Tune Level on the target. Switching to another Resonator ends the Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence enhancement.
Casting Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence removes Heaven's Clarity.

Swordlight Ward

Casting Intro Skill - Tonality Shift or Heavy Attack - Stringblade grants 1 stacks of Swordlight Ward.
Swordlight Ward stacks up to 1 times. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} of Swordlight Ward can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Sword Flight

While in the Sword Flight state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in Sword Flight continuously consumes Flight Qi.
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the Sword Flight state:
Sword Glide, Heavy Attack - Stringblade, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1, Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2, Severing Note: Ascendant, Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence, Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence, Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence, and Intro Skill - Tonality Shift.
- Exit the Sword Flight state by:
1. Casting Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3 or Plunging Attack.
2. Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.
3. Returning to the ground.
4. Switching to another Resonator.
5. Depleting all Flight Qi.

Sword Step

While in the Sword Flight state, hold Jump to leap up and dash forward a short distance.
Sword Step can only be cast once during Sword Flight.

Qin Heart

Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Sheathed Stance skills grants Qin Heart.
Qin Heart cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Sword Cadence

Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Drawn Stance skills grants Sword Cadence.
Sword Cadence cannot be gained while in the Ephemeral Transcendence state.

Heart Sword Intent

Can hold up to 100 points.
Dealing damage with Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence or Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence grants Heart Sword Intent.

abilities.name: Skillful Cooking
abilities.description: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

abilities.name: Lingering Song
abilities.description: Deal Aero DMG equal to 800% of Qingxiao's ATK.

abilities.name: Manifold Bloom
abilities.description:
Basic Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, consume STA to deal Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Answering Form

While in Answering Form and in mid-air, press Normal Attack to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease

While in Answering Form and in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, continuously consuming STA and dealing Electro DMG to the target.
Depleting all STA or switching to another Resonator ends the skill action early.

Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease

When the Normal Attack button is released during Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, Hsin casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, consuming STA to perform a Plunging Attack, transforming into the Moon Fox upon landing and dealing Electro DMG.
After casting Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and not in the Mechanism Dominion state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1 generates a Modular Heartlock at the target's position. Casting Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form, Dodge Counter - Illumining Form, or Resonance Skill - Illumining Form causes the Modular Heartlock to collapse, dealing Electro DMG.
Casting this skill consumes STA when Hsin is in mid-air.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form, consume STA to command Xuanfang Mechanisms, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3.

Upward Cut - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and on the ground, press Jump to cast this skill, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and Hsin is in mid-air, Resonance Skill - Illumining Form is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form and in the Mechanism Dominion state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form and in the Mechanism Dominion state, press Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned Stage 3.

abilities.name: Heartward by Moon
abilities.description:
Resonance Skill - Answering Form

While in Answering Form, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4.
Can be cast in mid-air.

If Hsin moves while on the ground within a short time after casting this skill, she turns into the Moon Fox.
- While in the Moon Fox form and out of combat, Hsin gains Dustless Tread. With Dustless Tread, Hsin can enter the target's aggro range without triggering combat. Dustless Tread is removed when Hsin enters combat, is switched out, or ends the Moon Fox form by having environmental, gameplay, or feature interactions.
- While in the Moon Fox form and out of combat, Hsin restores 6% of Max HP every 3s.
- Taking damage, failing to perform a Dodge with directional input while on the ground, or Dodging in mid-air will end the Moon Fox form. Switching to another Resonator or pressing Resonance Skill also ends the Moon Fox form. Press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4, which also ends the Moon Fox form.
- The Dash state continuously consumes STA when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.
- Resonance Liberation is disabled when Hsin is in the Moon Fox form.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form

While in Illumining Form and Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing Electro DMG.

abilities.name: Nexus Alight
abilities.description:
Formshift

Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector unlocks Formshift.
Cast Formshift to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin switches to Illumining Form, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the Heart Manifest state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in Illumining Form, engaging in quest dialogue, performing an environmental interaction with an animation, or using a Utility switches Hsin back to Answering Form to perform the corresponding action.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in Illumining Form can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in Illumining Form and in mid-air.

Pillars Across Heaven

After casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, when in Illumining Form with full Resonance Energy, Pillars Across Heaven becomes available.
Cast Pillars Across Heaven to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to Answering Form and exits the Heart Manifest state.

Edict

Casting Formshift grants Hsin 21 stacks of Edict for 45s. The effect cannot exceed 21 stacks and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After a Resonator on the field deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes Edict in the following 3s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:
- When Edict is consumed, summon a Soaring Pillar from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing Electro DMG.
- Edict can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by Soaring Pillar does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all Edict stacks are removed.

Heart Manifest

Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for 45s.
Entering the Heart Manifest state resets Hsin's Illumining Form.
While in the Heart Manifest state and in Illumining Form, if Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering. While in Answering Form, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Illumining.
Besides, if Hsin is still in Illumining Form after exiting Heart Manifest, and Pillars Across Heaven is locked, press Resonance Liberation to have Hsin cast Invoked Form: Answering.

Invoked Form: Answering

Hsin temporarily reverts to Answering Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Answering Form.

Invoked Form: Illumining

Hsin turns back into Illumining Form. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts Upward Cut - Illumining Form; if She is in mid-air, She casts Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form.

abilities.name: Tides of Succession
abilities.description:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, when Hsin casts Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison, Her ATK is increased by 50% for 8s. Switching to another Resonator or Resonance Mode ends this effect.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after Resonators in the team inflict Electro Flare, Hsin gains 25% Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to 2 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.
This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

abilities.name: Gleaning Simple Joys
abilities.description:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, the maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team gain 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare and Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict Electro Flare on a target, every 1 stack of Electro Flare inflicted grants Hisn 1 stack of Thunderglow, stacking up to 10 times.
While Hsin is in the Heart Manifest state, when targets within a certain range have 0 stacks of Electro Flare, inflict 1 stack of Electro Flare on the targets. If Thunderglow on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the targets:
- When Hsin inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the target, She also inflicts Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- When Fleeting Thunder is active, if the maximum stacks of Electro Flare on the target is increased, Hsin will inflict Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit again, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- Fleeting Thunder will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.
Exiting the Heart Manifest state or switching Resonance Mode removes the aforementioned effects.

abilities.name: Glance on a Whim
abilities.description:
Intro Skill - Answering Form

This skill becomes available while in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3 (when in Resonance Mode - Unison) or Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4 (when in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare).

Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison

This skill becomes available while in Answering Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
After casting this skill, press Normal Attack within a short time to cast Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3.

Intro Skill - Illumining Form

This skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison

This skill becomes available while in Illumining Form. Attack the target, dealing greater Electro DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.

abilities.name: Forms Turn, Heart Abides
abilities.description:
Forms Born of Heart

While in Answering Form, Hsin can gain and consume Answering Heart.
While in Illumining Form, Hsin can gain and consume Illumining Heart.

Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer

While in Answering Form, when Hsin's Answering Heart reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Answering Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA and 100 points of Answering Heart. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer grants Hsin Resolution of Wishes. This Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer consumes Resolution of Wishes to become Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, dealing greater DMG. Resolution of Wishes can only be gained once every 24s.
While casting Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer or Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector, if Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, unlock Resonance Liberation - Formshift.

Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons

While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 0 during the Mechanism Dominion state, Heavy Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons.
Hold Normal Attack to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG to the target, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons grants Hsin Law of Heaven. This Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons consumes Law of Heaven to become Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons, dealing greater DMG. Law of Heaven can only be gained once every 24s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons or Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons ends the Mechanism Dominion state and unlocks Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned

While in Illumining Form, when Hsin's Illumining Heart reaches 300 points and She is on the ground, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Hsin is on the ground, press Resonance Skill to deal Electro DMG to surrounding targets.
Casting Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned sends Hsin into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Mechanism Dominion

The Mechanism Dominion state lasts 13s.
While this state is active, Basic Attack - Illumining Form is replaced with Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned, and Dodge Counter - Illumining Form is replaced with Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned.
When Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned or Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned hits a target, Illumining Heart is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting Mechanism Dominion clears Illumining Heart.

Resonance Mode - Unison

While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger Unison Response, but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, the next Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.
- When Hsin triggers Unison Response, She gains Source Intent, and this cast of Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an Intro Skill without triggering Unison Response while holding Source Intent, She consumes Source Intent instead, and the Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill - Manifold Unison, dealing greater DMG.
- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting Intro Skill - Illumining Form or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison sends Hsin directly into the Mechanism Dominion state.

Resonance Mode - Electro Flare

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose Electro Flare stacks when it's triggered.
- After Resonators in the team inflict Electro Rage on a target, every 1 stacks of Electro Rage inflicted grants Hsin 1 stacks of Heart of Thunder, stacking up to 100 times, and consumes all Electro Rage stacks from that target. Heart of Thunder is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
